topic.label: Protects ratepayers from data center costs
topic.description: Who pays for grid upgrades and electricity costs caused by data centers: the facility or household and business ratepayers.
topic.suggested_question: If a new data center requires grid upgrades, who do you think should pay for them?

statement.quote_text: I don't want families paying higher electric bills so a data center can plug in.
statement.context_before: My view is we should only build them if they bring new clean power with them.
statement.context_after: Any project should have to tell us how much water and energy it uses every year.
statement.label: measured
